# Sengoku Craft

> *"Death is not the end. It is only the beginning of your journey."*

**Sengoku Craft** is a Minecraft 1.21.11 (Fabric) modpack that blends the brutality of feudal Sengoku Japan with the depth of a true RPG experience. Inspired by the aesthetics of Sekiro and FromSoftware games, every generated world is a wild, unforgiving land filled with dungeons, dangerous enemies and hidden secrets — where simply surviving is already a victory.

---

## About

Forget vanilla Minecraft. Here you will explore landscapes completely transformed by new terrain generation, descend into dark and brutal underground dungeons, face brand new mobs and build your base with the gears and machines of Create.

The experience was designed for those who want a challenging survival with the feel of a Japanese medieval RPG — without giving up visual quality or quality of life.

## Recommendations

- **Minimum RAM:** 4GB allocated to Minecraft
- **Recommended RAM:** 6–8GB for the best experience
- Shaders are supported via Iris — not included by default
